name: Normal Equations-based Solver
definition: A method to solve the box-constrained least squares problem $\forall i \in [1,...,n] : 0 \le x_i \le 1$ by formulating it as a quadratic programming problem.
summary: The Normal Equations-based Solver solves box-constrained least squares by explicitly constructing the Hessian matrix and using ADMM, distinguishing it from unconstrained and iterative solvers.
